(1) Toss a coin, heads一定朝上? False, not certain; possible tails.
(2) Roll a die, points一定不大于6? Standard die points 1-6, so definitely ≤6. True (certain event).
(3) To understand lifespan of a type of bulb, suitable to use census? Testing lifespan is destructive, should use sampling, not普查. False.
(4) "Tomorrow precipitation probability 80%" means tomorrow 80% area will rain? In probability, not exactly area percentage; common misconception. It means likelihood 80%, not 80% places. False. So only 1 correct. Answer A.
Need ensure if statement (2): 掷一颗骰子，点数一定不大于6. If a standard six-sided die, yes. In Chinese middle school, dice points are 1-6, so certain. So count=1. Final line "答案：A".

解析：
（1）抛一枚硬币，正面朝上是不确定事件，不是一定发生，错误；
（2）掷一颗骰子，点数只能是 1～6，一定不大于 6，正确；
（3）灯泡使用寿命测试具有破坏性，不宜采用普查，应采用抽样调查，错误；
（4）“降水概率为 80%”表示明天下雨的可能性较大，并不表示 80% 的地方下雨，错误。

因此正确的说法只有 1 个。

答案：A
